test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the given letter-cluster pairs, the first letter-cluster is related to the second letter-cluster following a certain logic. Study the given pairs carefully, and from the given options, select the pair that follows the same logic.

ABC : EFG

PQR : TUV
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

ABC : EFG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/778c01ae4484945977841e78da3074bbdf1a3d83d28bb62f98c8eb395da1daba.png] 

PQR : TUV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00beb090d31e1ae7c46792152939b13849fd6fbb62fa98c71cad9d203966f235.png] 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) PKL : RSM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a17532190470dc5cf2643dd66a4dabbc0532f4871a31fe4970d90c5275275fd6.png] 

Option 2) XYZ : BCD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e987982ca01449923a5178f681fb05de67dba694994aa62859f7bfd70ba183d5.png] 

Option 3) GHI : DEF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f6e557293d7e1f925df347bc293d324a00737e98ada1b15b03d23e298ab0f02.png] 

Option 4) MNO : PQR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb663fdd50a25f65c6479a8a9af0d2697daffdeaaa5f0133bd96c9dac0f781c9.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'XYZ : BCD' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
